rubric.role_summary: Senior investment banking leadership role originating digital infrastructure M&A advisory mandates, managing North American client relationships, overseeing deal execution, and leading SPAC and de-SPAC work.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior investment banking leadership role originating digital infrastructure M&A advisory mandates, managing North American client relationships, overseeing deal execution, and leading SPAC and de-SPAC work.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of investment banking or financial advisory experience with a digital infrastructure focus (data centers, fiber, and towers).
- Ability to structure, execute, and close sell-side M&A and related advisory mandates.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with SPAC/de-SPAC processes and public company M&A.
- Minimum ten years of investment banking or financial advisory experience with a digital infrastructure focus (data centers, fiber, and towers), and a proven track record in origination, business development, and client relationship management.
- Established network of existing or prospective clients in North America.
- Deal management and technical delivery capabilities.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Toronto, Canada area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
